meta.description: YukSaroy is an independent private platform with no relation to the state railway. Owners list, clients find and connect directly.

about.title: An independent private platform
about.lead: YukSaroy is a private company. It has no relation to the state railway: we are neither a carrier nor a terminal owner. We are the market: owners list, clients find and talk to the owner directly.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: A team that has worked in freight logistics for years. Finding a terminal, asking for a tariff and locating a free wagon still happen by phone; we turned that into one open catalog. Built for Uzbekistan, in three languages, with private funding.

what.heading: What the platform does
what.i1: Terminal services: tariff, hours, today's free slots, booking and documents.
what.i2: Private sidings registry: by station and node; the owner claims it and gets a page.
what.i3: Rail equipment and road carrier listings: rent or sale, with the owner's page.
what.i4: Companies: KYC badge, their objects, data through the open API.

open.title: Open price
open.body: Tariffs and listing prices are visible without login. Where the price is hidden there is no comparison; where there is no comparison there is no market.

fair.title: Fair ranking
fair.body: The list order is open: newest, price or distance. Premium sits higher only within that order and carries a badge. No hidden advertising.

owners.title: Owners' listings
owners.body: Every object belongs to its owner. The owner writes the terms and answers the inquiry. The platform is not a middleman and does not alter the data.

notRailway.heading: What we are not
notRailway.body: We are not the state railway, nor its division or agent. For wagon orders, tariff policy and timetables contact the railway authorities. We show only the market of private owners.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For a question, a demo or a partnership write through the form; we answer within 24 hours. The Telegram bot also has the catalog and inquiries.
